who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane weight lints (write_only_field .. swappable_parameters), fix-hello-1113
what: A lint that asks how an item is used across the workspace (is this field read, this variant constructed, this trait implemented elsewhere) has no query to ask: the dead kernel's per-store marks are private to blaze-diagnostics and per crate, lint_plan leaves out the bodies derives made, and definition ids differ between a crate's lib and test configurations.
cost: the weight lane wrote its own use-row walk and per-crate fold (rows.rs) beside the dead kernel's marks: two walks of every body for the same facts, and the join across configurations by where an item is written had to be invented again
cause: use facts are computed inside each consumer (dead's liveness, test_only, the weight lints) instead of once as rows every lint reads
class: whole-workspace facts derived ad hoc inside one lint family, so the next family re-derives them
prevention: one front-end query of use rows per body (subject by where it is written, way, role) with folds per crate, in a crate both blaze-diagnostics and blaze-lints depend on, as docs/v2/plan/design/end-state/check-test.md describes; dead, test_only and the weight lints all read it
workaround: weight/rows.rs is that shape already (body_uses per body, crate_uses per crate, readers per crate); move it down and port dead's marks onto it
